title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode6 Courageous Connection

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: No, how did we let the humans capture us...?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: What do we do?! What do we do?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
We need to find a way to escape...!
I know! Let's head towards that window and see if we can get out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
That was Nene's cue to appear...
Where is she...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait, could she be in trouble...?!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Oh no, they got caught!! What do I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Ah, there she is!
Now to slowly exit the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What's Robo-Nene doing back here? Isn't her scene coming up really soon...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sadly, she ran into a bit of trouble. Some children decided to play rough with her, which caused her to malfunction.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
C-Can you fix her?!
Without Robo-Nene, the final scene won't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene promised to buy me some time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll keep doing what I can here, so please help her as best you can, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okie-dokie!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
B-But what should we do?!
We're not supposed to go back out until after Nene's scene. If we go now, it'll ruin the whole story...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... The next scene is where Nene transforms after drinking the strange potion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how can we help her during all that...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What do I do...? There's no way I can save them both...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Normally, this is when I'm supposed to drink my potion and save them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I need to keep stalling until Robo-Nene's back on her feet...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No! You know what, I don't care about what happens to those two.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I kept telling them that going anywhere near these humans was really dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I got to see and experience so many new things because of them too.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: And not all humans are bad. The food they make is really good...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: And because of them...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Mommy, what's gonna happen to the merprince?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Save them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's just a little bit, but I think I managed to buy us some time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, I can't keep making the audience run around in circles like this. What else can I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh...!
Ms. Kazamatsuri...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What would she do at a time like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I were in her shoes when she was the Little Mermaid all those years ago...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's it...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just have to sing!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: The thought of standing up against humans terrifies me. Just thinking about all the terrible things that could happen to me because of that scares me so much...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But I can't just leave them behind...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I have to muster up as much courage as I can.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I need to be brave like the Little Mermaid when she decided to go ashore...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
Nene's singing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! But there aren't any singing scenes in this show!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: Whoa...! Such a beautiful song...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She's ad-libbing a whole song...?!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The melody and lyrics are a little different, but this sounds just like...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: It's like when I sang as the Little Mermaid...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There! She's back online!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you feel ready to go on stage?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Yes, I am ready!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, please let Nene know that we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene!
Robo-Nene's all fixed up!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Okay, I feel much better. Now I need to go and save them somehow...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait, I know! I still have that weird potion! The one for when we get into really big trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Please, I need a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I don't care if I dissolve into foam like the Little Mermaid in the book...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Wait... Huh?
Wh-What just happened to me?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that right now... I have to figure out a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez...
I thought my heart was literally going to explode...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, that was super duper extra wonderhoy!! Your song was really really wonderhoy too!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, don't scare me like that. You're gonna shorten my lifespan even more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I agree with Emu. Nicely done with those improvisations, Nene! Your song was wonderful too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
You kept the scene and story afloat despite the intense pressure. We couldn't have asked for more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene.
You gave our audience a wonderful reason to smile.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It was nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, you should be proud of what you just did. You looked at the situation and did whatever you could as an actress for your audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You became a really twinkly star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... I don't like relinquishing my throne, but today, you've earned it! You're the MVP!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Nene, that was great...
Mind if we have a word?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Kazamatsuri...!
You came all the way back here to see us...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, is she the one?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
She still has that same aura about her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to come and visit!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure. I should be thanking you for putting on such a wonderful show. Actually, that's what I'd like to discuss with you if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Oh, but... I still have to clean up...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's okay, Nene! We'll take care of that, so talk as much as you like♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, go! We insist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should be able to wrap things up there, so please, don't hesitate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I apologize for dropping in unannounced like that.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we? How about we head towards the beach and get out of your friends' hair?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Thank you for being so considerate!
